_note: Illustrative values for common California orchard products. Vapor pressures are approximate (mPa at about 25C), recalled from public pesticide property databases and NOT verified here; null means not filled in. Volatility: moderate if above about 1 mPa, otherwise low, high for known volatile formulations. Wind and temperature limits reflect typical label language, not any specific product label. The actual label governs.

pesticides.name: Captan
pesticides.notes: Bloom-time fungicide in almonds and stone fruit.

pesticides.name: Abamectin
pesticides.notes: Fine droplets for mite coverage increase drift sensitivity.

pesticides.name: Bifenthrin
pesticides.notes: Highly toxic to bees and aquatic life; drift to waterways is a key concern.

pesticides.name: Spinosad
pesticides.notes: Low volatility; drift risk is mainly droplet transport.

pesticides.name: Malathion
pesticides.notes: Measurable vapor loss in heat; avoid hot afternoons.

pesticides.name: Horticultural Oil
pesticides.notes: Risk of leaf burn above about 90F; not a drift issue but a label limit.

pesticides.name: Wettable Sulfur
pesticides.notes: Phytotoxic in heat; many labels say do not apply above 90F.

pesticides.name: Mancozeb
pesticides.notes: Published values vary (about 0.01 to 0.1 mPa).

pesticides.name: Glyphosate
pesticides.notes: Ground spray under trees; drift onto green bark or suckers injures trees.

pesticides.name: Oxyfluorfen
pesticides.notes: Drift onto foliage causes spotting; keep to coarse droplets.

pesticides.name: Chlorantraniliprole
pesticides.notes: Very low volatility; drift risk is droplet transport.

pesticides.name: Methoxyfenozide
pesticides.notes: Caterpillar growth regulator; vapor pressure not filled in, check a property database.

pesticides.name: Spirotetramat

pesticides.name: Spinetoram

pesticides.name: Imidacloprid
